ingredient_rules.reason: Industrial hydrogenated vegetable fats carry severe coronary heart disease risk and are strictly restricted (<0.2% trans fat) under FSSAI regulations.
ingredient_rules.source_name: FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards - Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations

ingredient_rules.pattern: palmolein|palm oil|fractionated palm|palm kernel|edible vegetable oil \(palm\)
ingredient_rules.reason: Palmolein contains ~45-50% saturated fatty acids (palmitic acid); flagged as primary frying fat contributor to HFSS classification in Indian snacks.

ingredient_rules.pattern: high fructose corn syrup|hfcs|liquid glucose|invert sugar syrup
ingredient_rules.reason: Refined concentrated industrial sugar syrup promotes rapid hepatic de novo lipogenesis and insulin resistance.
ingredient_rules.source_name: ICMR-NIN Dietary Guidelines for Indians, 2024 & WHO Guideline: Sugars intake for adults and children

ingredient_rules.reason: Intense artificial sweeteners require mandatory front-pack statutory disclosure under FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Regulations 2020.
ingredient_rules.source_name: FSSAI Gazette Notification: Labelling and Display Regulations 2020

ingredient_rules.reason: Synthetic food colours subject to maximum permitted levels (100 mg/kg) under FSSAI standards and EU warning requirements.
ingredient_rules.source_name: FSSAI Food Additives Standards & EFSA Safety Opinions

ingredient_rules.reason: Purified glutamates and ribonucleotides enhance sodium palatability, masking elevated sodium content in ultra-processed snacks.
